decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist of the album "Feel the Fire." Two distinct albums share this title: one by Family Brown (document D1S1) and another by Jermaine Jackson (document D4S1). Both are valid referents and do not conflict with each other. The original sources explicitly name both artists as creators of their respective albums titled *Feel the Fire*. There is no evidence of a single definitive referent, so both answers are preserved.
